items.title: Jerome Richardson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: he has Joe Williams and Nancy Wilson, and he didn’t want to do any more than that.

ctx.x: So you need someone else to go before you. And I have never had that because I guess, and it’s my own fault probably, but it’s hard to trust someone to handle my business. And there was only one person that I knew that I wanted to do it, and he wasn’t, he didn’t, I asked him, it was John Levy, and he has Joe Williams and Nancy Wilson, and he didn’t want to do any more than that. But some years back I asked him I said, “John, I’d like you to—” He said, “no, no more instrumentalists. After Cannonball, that was the…
He would have been a good one.
